ruleDefinitions.name: Potential AVKkid.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "AVKkid.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\AVKkid\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\G\\ DATA\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\G\\ DATA\\\\.*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\AVKKid\\\.exe$") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\G\\ DATA\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\G\\ DATA\\\\"))))
